summaryForNext: Goals 1,2,5,6,7 are wiring against proven substrate; goals 3 (automation-bias countermeasures) and 4 (outcome tracking) are new construction and carry the differentiation — no surveyed competitor has either. Research inverts two intuitions: idea SCORING is invalidated by the Ideation-Execution Gap (execution must be the terminal artifact), and persona panels do NOT produce diversity (Diversity Collapse + MAD martingale). Mobile: 107/145 skills are prompt-only and portable today; relay-first beats P2P (>90% cellular CGNAT, ~40% symmetric; iOS suspends connections) and sovereign-sync is already a blind relay. WARNINGS: scope now spans 3 areas and should split into two phases (§8); artifact-mode review packets are structurally blind to skill files (find -maxdepth 2) so any skill-path claim draws an unverifiable finding — fix before it trains reviewers to discount real findings.
